title: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months
summary: Around two-thirds (65%) now disapprove of the way President Donald Trump is handling the U.S. military action in Iran, while a third (33%) approve.

title: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative
summary: The costs of many household essentials are a top economic concern for most Americans – much as they were four years ago on the eve of the last midterm election.

title: Which Health and Wellness Influencers Talk About Medical Topics? Mostly Healthcare Professionals
summary: Influencers who describe themselves as healthcare professionals tend to post much more often about topics like medical conditions, mental health or treatments requiring the supervision of a doctor.

title: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
summary: Just over half of health and wellness content on social media focuses on healthy living, while about a third discusses medical topics. And 38% of posts have a product or service promotion.

title: Americans Are Negative About Social Media’s Impact on Democracy – and the Rest of the World Is Catching Up
